fees.notes: StudyMalaysia course page: international fees RM85,225. MSU official programme pages publish Malaysian fees only; no official international fee schedule available. Source: https://studymalaysia.com/what/course/MSU/0057141/ (accessed 2026-09-18).

requirements.general: Passed Sijil Tinggi Persekolahan Malaysia (STPM) or equivalent with full pass in two subjects including General Studies or NGMP at least 2.00; Passed two subjects at A Level; Passed the Matriculation certificate from the Ministry of Education Malaysia; Passed a Diploma in a related field from any Higher Education Provider (HEP) with a CGPA of 2.00; Passed Matriculation/Foundation with a minimum CGPA of 2.00 out of 4.00; Passed Unified Examination Certificate (UEC) with at least grade B in 5 subjects; Other qualifications recognized as equivalent by the Malaysian government.
